caveats: About 4% of orders are fulfilled on a different calendar day than their appointment date. This file buckets by when work actually happened, so it will not reconcile to the Order matrix tab, which uses appointment_date. That is by design.

fulfilled_at is written at completion, not at arrival. For a 15-minute pickup checklist the offset is small; for a 120-minute delivery the timestamp reads roughly two hours late. Treat the Delivery layer as completion time.

On-flex visits are bucketed by their booked slot, not arrival. Where both timestamps exist, members check in an average of 31 minutes early, so real OFS demand lands earlier than this file shows, frequently in the preceding hour. The buckets are left unshifted; state the offset in the UI instead.
warnings: El Monte: first fulfilled order 2026-08-27, one week before the window start; ramp-like pattern but rampFlag is false under the inside-window rule.
Ramp check uses lifetime first fulfilled order per site; the windowed MIN in the specified ramp query always equals the window start (2026-09-03) for every site and cannot detect launches.
